Name: Dungeon Master Map Tool
Author: Dungeon Master Map Tool
Description: Control the Dungeon Master Map Tool from your Stream Deck: music categories, sound effects, fog, lighting, the player view and map switching. Keys show the application's own artwork and stay highlighted while their control is active. Requires Settings > Local control API to be enabled in the application.

Actions.Name: Music category
Actions.Tooltip: Plays a music category, or stops it when it is already playing. Stays highlighted while the category is the one that plays.

Actions.Name: Sound effect
Actions.Tooltip: Starts or stops one sound effect loop. Stays highlighted while the loop runs.

Actions.Name: DM control
Actions.Tooltip: Presses any DM control button or toggle, such as Night, Fog on/off or Freeze player view. Toggles stay highlighted while they are on.

Actions.Name: DM value
Actions.Tooltip: Sets, increases or decreases a slider or spinner, or sets a color picker such as the effect color.

Actions.Name: DM dropdown option
Actions.Tooltip: Selects one option of a dropdown such as the weather type or the effect texture. Stays highlighted while that option is selected.

Actions.Name: Switch map
Actions.Tooltip: Opens a library map, optionally at a given level. Stays highlighted while that map is open.
